title: Discontinued UL-Listed Fire Damper Model Substitution

input.extracted_text:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
RFI Number: RFI-2026-005
Subject: Proposed Substitution for Discontinued Ruskin FSD-60 Fire/Smoke Dampers
Contract Reference: CON-2026-MEP-002
Raised Date: 2026-03-20
Due Date: 2026-03-27
Status: closed

QUESTION:
The specified motorized combination fire/smoke damper model Ruskin FSD-60 is discontinued by manufacturer. We propose substituting Greenheck Model FSD-211 which meets identical 1-1/2 hour UL 555 and UL 555S Class II leakage ratings. Please confirm acceptability.

RESPONSE:
Response Date: 2026-03-24
Accepted as equal. Submit formal material submittal SUB-MEP-088 for resident engineer stamp.
